name: godot-intake
short_description: Enter a Godot project through project.godot, quick context, docs index, and current status.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot project intake, project entry, context loading, identity checks, root detection, or low-token onboarding for an existing Godot project.
task: 确认真实 Godot 项目根，读取 hot context 和 docs router，再按任务打开最小 current/status/next-step 文件。

name: godot-docs
short_description: Clean, route, audit, or synchronize Godot project docs without duplicating truth.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot docs cleanup, docs routing, Chinese-first documentation, source-of-truth repair, current/history/next-steps synchronization, or indexed documentation maintenance.
task: 按 source of truth 修复 docs/current、docs/plans、docs/history 和 docs/reference 的职责边界，避免重复事实。

name: godot-plan
short_description: Create ready-to-implement Godot gameplay plans with tier, readiness, contracts, and verification.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot planning, GDD planning, task breakdown, readiness review, implementation contracts, milestone slicing, or plan quality checks before implementation.
task: 先判断 task shape 和档位，再写可执行 plan、owned files、verification、manual acceptance 和 readiness。

name: godot-execution
display_name: Godot Execution / Godot 执行纪律
short_description: Keep Godot implementation bounded with task shape, minimal loop, pause points, and verification rhythm.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot execution discipline, implementation flow, scope control, side-issue handling, validation rhythm, or process correction during a Godot task.
task: 约束 task shape、最小闭环、暂停点、side issue 分类、验证节奏和文档同步时机。

name: godot-reference-research
display_name: Godot Reference Research / Godot 参考研究
short_description: Research player-visible gameplay references before planning feel, route, UI, Boss, or pacing work.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot reference research, external gameplay references, successful game examples, open-source implementation comparison, Boss design, movement feel, UI flow, camera readability, or route pacing references.
task: 为玩家可见或主观体验计划查 2-4 个同类成功例子或可靠实现，并转成本项目 scope、risk、validation 和 non-goal。

name: godot-scene-signal
display_name: Godot Scene Signal / Godot 场景信号
short_description: Check Godot scene tree, node paths, signals, resources, InputMap, and Autoload contracts.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot scene/signal checks, node path validation, resource ownership, InputMap or Autoload review, scene wiring, or .tscn contract inspection.
task: 先读真实 .tscn / .gd，再确认 node path、sender/receiver/payload、resource instance、InputMap 和 Autoload 边界。

name: godot-gdscript
short_description: Review or write Godot 4 GDScript with API, ownership, runtime path, and code-quality constraints.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot GDScript rules, script review, Godot 4 API checks, gameplay code quality, script contracts, runtime-path debugging, or code-shape planning.
task: 按 Godot 4 API、script contract、ownership、extension point 和 visible runtime path 审查或计划代码。

name: godot-validation
short_description: Run or plan Godot validation, smoke tests, output scans, and manual playtest handoff.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot validation, smoke tests, manual playtest, output scanning, validation gates, failure logs, or completion checks before handoff.
task: 分开自动验证和 manual playtest，扫描 Godot ERROR / SCRIPT ERROR / push_error，并输出可复测步骤。

name: godot-closeout
short_description: Close out Godot work with docs sync, history, next steps, validation evidence, and commit policy.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot closeout, session handoff, docs/history sync, commit preparation, manual acceptance recording, milestone handoff, or next-step cleanup.
task: 同步 current/status/history/next steps，记录验证、人工验收或免审理由，并按项目 policy 决定 commit。

name: godot-failure-debug
display_name: Godot Failure Debug / Godot 失败诊断
short_description: Diagnose Godot behavior that did not change, validation failures, runtime-path issues, and stale docs.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot failure debugging, behavior did not change, smoke failure diagnosis, visible runtime path checks, stale scene/script/resource routing, or validation mismatch triage.
task: 优先检查 played scene、attached script、main route、resource instance、signal route 和验证输出，而不是只补测试。

name: godot-org-health
display_name: Godot Org Health / Godot 组织健康
short_description: Review Godot docs, main scene scripts, scenes, and smoke tests for organization efficiency risks.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot organization health, project organization review, docs bloat review, large main_game.gd or smoke test warning review, roadmap slimming, or low-token structure cleanup.
task: 检查 active docs 是否吸历史，以及主场景脚本、scene、smoke test 是否需要按 owner / route / assertion family 拆分。

name: godot-mcp-editor
display_name: Godot MCP Editor / Godot MCP 编辑器
short_description: Use Godot MCP/editor evidence alongside file evidence and manual acceptance boundaries.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot MCP, editor workflow, tool evidence, file evidence, editor validation, project metadata checks, or MCP-assisted Godot project inspection.
task: 区分 MCP/editor tool evidence、file evidence 和 manual acceptance，不用工具输出替代源码或场景真相。

name: godot-skill-maintenance
display_name: Godot Skill Maintenance / Godot Skill 维护
short_description: Maintain the Godot workflow skill, references, wrappers, scripts, metadata, and validation gates.
description: Use when the user explicitly invokes Godot skill maintenance, skill update, workflow rule changes, wrapper skill installation, metadata sync, self-check updates, or external workflow material review.
task: 保持 SKILL.md 精简、reference 可路由、scripts 可验证、metadata 同步，并运行 skill self-check。
